request: Analyze GSE315915 for PMID 42003465 (Exercise Metabolic Memory Halts Pathological Cardiac Hypertrophy via PDK4.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq (Illumina PE150, HISAT2/StringTie/featureCounts, GRCm38) of whole hearts
final.primary_estimand: Effect of exercise-induced hypertrophic preconditioning (EHP: 3-week swimming followed by 1-week rest) versus 4-week sedentary on myocardial gene expression in adult male WT mice (metabolic memory after hypertrophy regression)
final.sample_inclusion: 5 EHP and 5 sedentary hearts (S2.2.p1, FIG2 A); no exclusions stated
planned_contrasts: EHP vs SED (S2.2.p1; FIG2 B-C; paper: 92 DEGs)
final.paper_method: DESeq2 ~ group, BH-adjusted P (FIG2 legend; GEO data_processing)
final.paper_results: 92 DEGs; Pdk4 the only DEG in the glucose metabolic process set (M13879), lower in EHP (FIG2 B-D); Lonp1 not different (S2.5.p1); calcineurin/NFAT and arachidonic-acid genes not different (S2.6.p1)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.2.p1: RNA-seq on hearts of 5 EHP and 5 sedentary mice after 1-week rest following 3-week swimming; 92 DEGs at |log2FC|>0.5 and adjusted P<0.05. FIG2 legend: DESeq2, BH-adjusted P. GEO data_processing repeats DESeq2 + BH but writes the fold rule as '>= 0.5'; main text and figure legend use '>' so the paper's strict rule is used.

checks: GEO series GSE315915 has 10 heart samples: 5 'sedentary 4w' and 5 'swimming 3w + sedentary 1w', titles Sedentary 1-5 / EHP 1-5, matching the paper's 5 EHP vs 5 Sed design
contact Cankun Zheng, Nanfang Hospital, matches the study group; extract protocol names the sedentary and EHP groups collected one week after swimming ended
matrix columns S1-S5/E1-E5 equal the library names in the metadata description field

ownership.reasoning: Accession, group labels, n per group, tissue and timing all match S2.2.p1 / FIG2 A.

alignment.reasoning: inspect: matrix column names sit inside the description field ('Library name: sample 1,S1'); the trailing token is extracted as the key. Group comes from the title (Sedentary n / EHP n), consistent with characteristics treatment.

final.source: GSE315915_mRNA_raw_count.txt.gz (transcript-level, 62,384 ENSMUST rows) collapsed to Ensembl genes by summing transcripts (prep/collapse_transcripts.py)
final.paper_input: gene-level read counts (featureCounts) analysed with DESeq2

matrix.reasoning: All values integer, 0 to 3.4M, library sizes 12.7-17.4M; GEO data_processing: 'reads count matrix ... featureCounts' and 'The tab-delimited text file includes raw counts for each sample'. The deposited file is indexed by Ensembl transcript IDs while the paper reports genes, so transcript counts were summed per parent gene (Ensembl REST lookup); retired transcripts that no longer resolve were dropped (declared deviation). Integer sums remain valid counts for DESeq2.

design.reasoning: Single two-level factor, 5 vs 5 independent animals (S2.2.p1). All mice WT; sex not stated for the RNA-seq cohort (adult male per S2.3.p1 context) - the suitability sex check will report.

covariance.reasoning: Independent animals, no batch, lane or pairing recorded in GEO; paper models group only.

paper_route.reason: gene counts reconstructed by summing deposited transcript counts

deviations: gene-level counts reconstructed from transcript-level deposit; transcripts retired from current Ensembl dropped

method.reasoning: Paper used DESeq2 (FIG2 legend); integer counts support it.

final.deviation_note: GEO data_processing writes |log2FC| >= 0.5; the article text and FIG2 legend write > 0.5, used here.

threshold.reasoning: S2.2.p1 and FIG2 legend: |log2(FC)|>0.5 and BH-adjusted P<0.05.

caveats: gene counts reconstructed from transcript-level deposit
pydeseq2 vs R DESeq2 may differ in independent filtering / dispersion shrinkage

study.reasoning: Paper: 92 DEGs, Pdk4 down in EHP; Lonp1 explicitly not different (S2.5.p1).
